page.layout: One page of a table. Left column: names of fractions (Dodrans, Bes, Septunx, Semis) with a note on the scruple. Centre column: numbers running down the page. Right of the centre: the common note "Notae communes". A vertical strip of numbers runs along the right edge, with the word "Quin" at its foot. A digitiser's link at the foot is left out.
page.notes: The right-hand strip of numbers is printed vertically along the edge; its order is read top to bottom. The word at the foot, "Quin", is partly obscured and is uncertain. The left-column labels are set in bold italic and "Scrupula unius gradus." is printed in three lines. The lines are shown beside the numbers they stand against. Some faint stains and show-through are not transcribed.
